name: Death
description: A blue glowing ghostly figure with a far-eastern accent who tells Aiman 'Not yet' and says they are too early.

description_citations.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One

timeline.summary: At night Aiman sees a glowing blue ghost he takes for Death, which says it is too early and that it does not happen here, then vanishes.
